title: Canned job warning names a typed vendor part by the inactive part's number
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANVEND-01) is tracked at {Location-A} and is inactive.
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANVEND-03) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • Canned job {Canned-job-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANVENDSRC line") holds {Part-C} and a vendor part typed in by hand as {Number-A} (for example zzautotest.pl.canvend.01), which equals {Part-A} once upper and lower case, hyphens and periods are ignored.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) at {Location-A} is open and has no lines.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1}.
  2. Click "New Line".
  3. Type the start of {Canned-job-A} in Title and pick the {Canned-job-A} suggestion.
  4. Click "Save & Close".
  5. Read the warning at the bottom right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The new line {Canned-job-A} holds {Part-C} only; the vendor part {Number-A} is not on it.
  • Step 5: One warning shows: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {Part-A}." It names the inventory part's own number {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANVEND-01), not the typed {Number-A}. It stays until closed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R9a, S9-R10, S9-R10b, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: boards 6.4 and 6.5 show an inventory part, not a typed vendor part; the canvas note on 6.5 says each part is named by the inventory part's own number. Product's 9 Oct answer (Chris Ward, question 7). SV-10822 acceptance criteria. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R9a: “A canned job part that was typed in as a vendor part, and whose number matches an inactive part at this location, is left out too.”
  • PRD Story 9 context note: “in S9-R9a, S9-R15, S9-R16 and S9-R17 a number "matches" an inactive part when the two are the same once upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored. A number that also belongs to an active part at this location is not refused.”
  • S9-R10: “When a canned job leaves out parts, the system shows one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." The warning stays until the user closes it.”
  • S9-R10b: “The warning names each part by the inventory part's own number, as it shows on the Inactive tab, not by the number as typed in the canned job.”
  • SV-10822 acceptance criteria: “Given a canned job with a vendor part typed by hand as FF5507, and FF-5507 is inactive at this location, when the job is applied, then the part is left out and the warning names it as FF-5507.”
